Value: The study will require a total of 25 subjects to establish Noninferiority of the treatment group to the control group with desired power of 89.144%. This test is based on a 1-Sided difference of means test for a 2x2 crossover design for continuous response data with significance level 0.027. The difference in means between treatment and control groups under the alternative hypothesis is 0.77. This test assumes a Noninferiority margin of 1.8 and root mean square of 1.1. The allocation ratio is 1.2, and therefore of the 25 subjects, 11 are allocated to the control-treatment sequence and 14 subjects are allocated to the treatment-control sequence.
